title: Naruto Live-Action Movie Gets Promising Update From Director With Tease for More Soon
content:
Naruto is now in the works on a new live-action movie, and the director behind it all has shared a promising update on how it’s all coming along so far. Masashi Kishimoto’s Naruto is fast approaching the 25th anniversary of its original debut, and thus fans have begun to see the franchise making its return with all sorts of surprising new projects now in development . But the biggest surprise has to be a new live-action movie with Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day director Destin Daniel Cretton is now overseeing this new Naruto live-action feature film debut with a worldwide casting process kicking off earlier this Summer . The Naruto franchise took the stage during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend with all sorts of teases for the future, and it included a special message from Cretton on how the new live-action movie is progressing, “We’re hard at work and will have more to share soon.”

Live-Action Naruto Movie Director Teases Progress & Next Update

“When we kicked off our worldwide search for Team 7 this summer, I talked about what an honor it is to bring Kishimoto-sensei’s incredible world and characters to life,” Cretton revealed in a new statement to Naruto fans during the New York Comic Con 2026 weekend. “The further we get into making this film, the more excited I am about what we’re creating.” The director then got even deeper into what about the franchise and titular character appeals to him the most , “What I’ve always loved about Naruto is that he’s the character who might normally get sidelined as a sidekick.”

“He’s excitable, he tries too hard, and people underestimate him,” Cretton continued. “But he has an incredible heart.” Through the statement, it’s also clear that Cretton really gets it, “No matter how many times he fails or gets knocked down, he never stops believing in himself or fighting for the people he loves. That spirit is at the heart of the story we’re telling.” But Cretton was also sure to ease any potential worries that there won’t be an appropriate amount of care put into it, “These characters mean so much to so many people, myself included, and I carry that with me as we make this film.”

When Does Naruto’ s Live-Action Movie Come Out?

“We’re approaching the world, relationships, and journeys Kishimoto-sensei created with a lot of care, and we want to capture what makes NARUTO so special,” Cretton stated. “We’re hard at work and will have more to share soon. Until then, thank you for your passion, your patience, and for being along for the ride. I can’t wait for you to see what’s ahead!” But as of right now, the new live-action Naruto film has yet to set a release date or window with production slated to kick off soon enough. Though that might mean the wait for the next Spider-Man movie could be further off.

Destin Daniel Cretton will be directing the new live-action Naruto movie for Lionsgate Pictures, and is also co-writing it alongside Tasha Huo. Cretton is also a co-producer on the film alongside Jeyun Munford through Hisako with Avi Arad, Ari Arad and Emmy Yu of Arad Productions, and Jeremy Latcham. The worldwide casting search for Naruro, Sasuke and Sakura is underway, but no official cast for any of the other characters has been revealed as of this time .

What are you hoping to see for the new Naruto live-action movie from the director behind Spider-Man: Brand New Day ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Dragon Ball Super Returns After 8 Years With Epic New Anime Opening – Watch Now
content:
Dragon Ball Super has made its official return with a newly enhanced anime series , and with it has kicked off its grand comeback with epic new opening and ending theme sequences. Dragon Ball Super’ s original TV anime series made its debut over a decade ago, and can now be considered a classic thanks to the fact it’s been eight long years since fans have last seen the series in action. But the franchise has begun a massive comeback tour with the premiere of a new remake series.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus is a newly enhanced version of the original TV anime series going all the way back to the Battle of Gods arc . Featuring touched up animation, new visual effects, new music and more, this new series also introduces a new set of opening and ending themes that perfectly help fans usher in this new era of the long running franchise. You can check out the new opening for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus below to help celebrate its premiere.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus Debuts New Opening & Ending Themes

The new opening theme for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus (which you can find in the video above) is titled “ONOGAMI” as performed by MEGATERA・ZERO, and the new ending theme (which you can find in the video below) is titled “Kan Peki No Peki” as performed by VK Blanka. These new themes aren’t the only new elements on offer as Toei Animation has been touting this new series as an “enhanced” version of the now classic TV series as it adjusts the Battle of Gods, Resurrection F and Universe 6 arcs from that original run.

Dragon Ball Super: Beerus has yet to reveal how many episodes it’s going to stick around for, but this does open up the franchise to eventually remaking future arcs of the series in this same way. There are some questions as to how it’s all coming together, however, as Koichi Yamadera (the voice actor behind Beerus in the Japanese dub) revealed in an official interview for the series that the voice cast isn’t recording new dialogue for its release, “They’re taking what we recorded back then and building something new out of it — it felt like a stroke of luck.” We’ll just have to see how that works out in practice.

What’s New for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus?

Dragon Ball Super ‘s return this Fall is an exciting one. Not only is this remake series bringing the franchise back to a regular broadcast schedule after nearly a decade, but it’s the start of a new wave of projects for the future. Dragon Ball recently kicked off the 40th anniversary celebration of the late Akira Toriyama’s original manga debut with Shonen Jump magazine, and it’s resulted in some cool new anime. What’s coming sometime after this is brand new too as it readies for a massive arc .

Dragon Ball Super: The Galactic Patrol is a brand new anime currently in the works with Toei Animation. No release date or window has been announced for the new series as of this time, nor have any production staff been revealed for it thus far. But it will be adapting the Galactic Patrol Prisoner arc that has only been seen in the official manga release. This is one of two arcs that have yet to be animated, so it’s all very exciting.

You can find Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ‘ premiere streaming with Crunchyroll and Hulu on October 11th, and with Netflix beginning on October 17th. How do you like the new opening and ending for Dragon Ball Super: Beerus ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: The Apothecary Diaries Highlights Maomao x Jinshi With New Movie Trailer – Watch
content:
The Apothecary Diaries is gearing up to hit the big screen with its debut feature film effort, and a new trailer is teasing fans with some of its big Maomao and Jinshi moments. The anime adaptation for Natsu Hyuga’s original novel series has made its return for its third season as part of the ongoing Fall 2026 anime schedule , but there is still much more for the franchise on the way. The anime is hitting the big screen across Japan later this year, so fans have a new movie to look forward to.

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure will first be making its debut across theaters in Japan this December, and it features a brand new story from the original creator that has not been seen in the novel or manga releases. This means some brand new moments for Maomao and Jinshi that even the most dedicated fans won’t see coming, and the main duo is being highlighted with a special character trailer that you can check out in action below.

The Apothecary Diaries Movie Shares New Maomao and Jinshi Trailer

The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure will be coming to theaters in Japan on December 11th, but luckily it has already confirmed plans for an international release. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment have revealed that they will be releasing the new film across theaters in North America sometime in the future , but a release date or window for the film’s international launch has yet to be confirmed as of this time. But there’s still plenty to be hyped for with a brand new story slated for the upcoming project.

Directed by Norihiro Naganuma for TOHO Animation STUDIO, The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure teases that the original story for the film will see Jinshi tasked with fulfilling the final wishes of a concubine that had died years prior. But upon inspecting her remains, it’s revealed that her body’s in pristine condition. This sparks an entirely new mystery for Maomao as the two head to a whole new region in order to get to the bottom of what happened to the concubine and send her off in peace. It seems like it’s going to be a story fitting of a big screen scale.

What’s Going on With The Apothecary Diaries ?

You can now check out the latest episodes of The Apothecary Diaries now streaming with Crunchyroll as new episodes are released this Fall. This third season will be running for 24 episodes with the first cour wrapping up later this year before the anime then returns for its second half sometime in April 2027 as part of the Spring 2027 anime schedule. But as the anime works through a new season and gets ready for its feature film debut, there’s even more for the franchise now in the works for 2027 and beyond.

The Apothecary Diaries is also in the works on its official video game debut with a new release coming sometime next year. But there’s even an official live-action series now in the works with Prime Video . Series creator Natsu Hyuga has already given the live-action adaptation their seal of approval too, so there’s a good chance it’s going to be just as good as each of the adaptations seen thus far.

What are you hoping to see from Jinshi and Maomao in The Apothecary Diaries movie? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: New Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Teases Massive New Enemy – Watch Now
content:
Godzilla Minus Zero is now only a month away from its worldwide takeover across theaters , and now fans have gotten the best look at what to expect yet with a final trailer helping to show all of it off. Godzilla Minus One kicked off a whole new era for Toho and the legendary kaiju franchise. Not only was is it the first film in the franchise to release for the Reiwa era, but it was also released to celebrate the 70th anniversary of Godzilla ‘s original debut. Then it just exploded from there.

Continuing on from the Academy Award winning success of the first film , Godzilla Minus Zero is picking up with the next phase of the story two years after the events of Godzilla Minus One . Godzilla Minus Zero is bringing back Godzilla as the kaiju stomps across Japan once more, and there’s a whole other threat lingering in the film that fans are getting the first look at with this new trailer. You can check out the final trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero below.

When Does Godzilla Minus Zero Come Out?

Godzilla Minus Zero will first be hitting theaters in Japan on November 3rd, and it will then be followed by its release in the United States and Canada on November 6th with IMAX options also available. This is a huge first for the franchise as it’s going to be an incredibly quick turnaround between its Japanese and North America releases. Not only that, but it’s the first-ever Japanese production to be filmed for IMAX. This goes to show just how big of a deal this is going to be for the franchise, and why fans should make sure to catch it in theaters when it hits.

Takashi Yamazaki, director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor for Godzilla Minus One , also returned to oversee the sequel film for Toho Studios with ROBOT producing and SHIROGUMI Inc. behind the visual effects. Godzilla Minus Zero also brings back some familiar faces from the first film too with the likes of Ryunosuke Kamiki return as Koichi Shikishima alongside Minami Hamabe as Noriko Oishi, Hidetaka Yoshioka as Kenji Noda, Yuki Yamada as Shiro Mizushima, Kuranosuke Sasaki as Seiji Akitsu, Sakura Ando as Sumiko Ota, and Miou Tanaka as Tatsuo Hotta all confirmed thus far.

What Is Godzilla Minus Zero About?

Godzilla Minus Zero takes place in 1949, two years after the events of Godzilla Minus One . Shikishima and the others barely survived their first confrontation with Godzilla, and in the midst of recovery are now having to face destruction from the kaiju once more. All the while, there’s been a tease of an additional kaiju that’s going to really shake things up as a challenge to the godly being. And with its current IMAX scope, it’s clear this is going to be bigger in a whole lot of ways than the first film.

Godzilla Minus Zero is a first for the franchise with it not only being the first IMAX produced film, and the first one to have such a quick worldwide release, but it’s also the first film in the franchise to get an R rating . Bigger, bloodier, and lots of surprises in store could mean one of the best Godzilla films yet, and that’s a lot to say after that first film hit such heights. How do you like the newest trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero ? Let us know all of your thoughts about it in the comments!

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Streams Final Trailer
content:
TOHO began streaming the final trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , on Sunday.

Min Tanaka ( 47 Ronin , live-action Rurouni Kenshin films) plays biologist Kanji Murakami. He joins returning cast members Ryūnosuke Kamiki (Koichi Shikishima), Minami Hamabe (Noriko Ōishi), and Hidetaka Yoshioka (Noda) from Godzilla Minus One . Also returning in the cast are Yūki Yamada (Shiro Mizushima), Kuranosuke Sasaki (Seiji Akitsu), Sakura Andō (Sumiko Ota), and Miō Tanaka (Tatsuo Hotta).

Yamazaki returns as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor. Naoki Satō is also back to compose the music. Production is currently undrway at TOHO Studios, with ROBOT producing the film and Shirogumi Inc. handling the visual effects.

The sequel fillm will open in Japan on November 3. November 3 is "Godzilla Day," which was the anniversary of the first Godzilla film's November 3, 1954 release. Godzilla Minus One similarly opened in Japan on November 3, 2023. (Godzilla Day falls on a Tuesday this year, but it is also the Japanese holiday known as Culture Day.)

GKIDS and TOHO will release the film in North America on November 6. This is the first time a Japan-produced Godzilla film will open in Japan and in North America in the same week.

This is the first Japanese film to meet the standard to advertise itself as "Filmed for IMAX." In addition to opening in Japan and North America, it will open in the same week in Latin America, Europe, Asia, the Middle East, Australia, and New Zealand. The companies stated they will announce additional international release dates at a later time. TOHO acquired GKIDS in October 2024.

Godzilla Minus One has earned more than US$116 million worldwide. According to Box Office Mojo, the film has earned an estimated US$57,144,669 in the United States. The film was the third highest-grossing foreign-language film in the United States as of 2024.

Netflix is streaming the film and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color , the black-and-white version of the film, worldwide on Netflix . In North America, Godzilla Minus One and Godzilla Minus One /Minus Color are additionally available for digital rental and digital purchase on Amazon, Apple iTunes , Google Play , Microsoft , FandangoNOW/ VUDU , inDemand, XBOX, and Vubiquity. In Japan, the film is streaming exclusively (in color and monochrome) on Amazon Prime Video .

Godzilla Minus One won the Best Visual Effects award in the 96th Academy Awards in March 2024. The film is the first Japanese film to win in this category, and the first Godzilla film to be nominated for an Oscar.

Yamazaki's first English-language film Grandgear will open on February 18, 2028.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Releases Maomao and Jinshi Character Trailer
content:
The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure has released a new character trailer for Maomao and Jinshi ahead of the film’s December 11, 2026 premiere in Japan. The video is the first in a four-day series of character promotional videos (PVs) being released for the upcoming movie. The movie is the first theatrical feature in The Apothecary Diaries franchise and features a new mystery written by original series creator. Norihiro Naganuma directs, with TOHO Animation STUDIO handling animation production. title: 'Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi' Reveals Main Cast, 2027 Debut
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Enma Akiyama 's Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi ( Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend ) manga revealed the main cast and a key visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.

Voice actors Rina Kawaguchi ( Witch Watch ) and Tomoya Itou ( Sentai Red Isekai de Boukensha ni Naru ) are starring as Noa Saotome and Rihito Ootsuka, respectively.

Shinsuke Yanagi ( Jaku-Chara Tomozaki-kun , Mamahaha no Tsurego ga Motokano datta ) is directing the anime at feel. , with Keiichirou Oochi ( 5-toubun no Hanayome , Kanojo mo Kanojo ) handling the series composition. Yumiko Yamamoto ( Shichisei no Subaru , Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld ) is designing the characters.

Akiyama began publishing the comedy manga in Weekly Young Jump magazine in July 2023. Shueisha released the 11th volume on July 17, with the 12th volume scheduled for an October 19 release.

A promotional video was released to commemorate the release of the first volume in October 2023. It features voice actors Mayu Yoshioka ( Wake Up, Girls! ) and Kengo Kawanishi ( 3-Gatsu no Lion ) as Noa Saotome and Rihito Ootsuka, respectively.

The series was nominated in the 10th Next Manga Awards and came 8th in the print category.

title: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend TV Anime Unveils Main Cast, 2027 Debut
content:
Kadokawa unveiled the first key visual, main cast members, and the 2027 premiere for the television anime of Enma Akiyama 's Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend. ( Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi. ) manga on Sunday.

The anime will star:

Rina Kawaguchi as Noa Saotome

Tomoya Itō as Rihito Ōtsuka

The manga's story centers on Rihito Ōtsuka — a laid-back and unbothered guy, and an employee in a game company, whose motto in life is to conserve energy — and Noa Saotome, his senior and an art director. Noa, a quintessential career woman, is deeply trusted by her superiors and admired by her juniors. But one day, Rihito accidentally discovers Noa's secret side that she strictly keeps hidden. This starts the "friends only" after-work relationship between Noa and Rihito.

Shinsuke Yanagi ( Bottom-tier Character Tomozaki , Senpai is an Otokonoko , High School Prodigies Have It Easy Even In Another World ) is directing the anime at feel. , Keiichirō Ōchi ( I Made Friends with the Second Prettiest Girl in My Class , The Yakuza's Guide to Babysitting , The Quintessential Quintuplets ) is in charge of series scripts, and Yumiko Yamamoto ( Seven Senses of the Re'Union , Sword Art Online: Alicization - War of Underworld , Yohane the Parhelion -SUNSHINE in the MIRROR ) is designing the characters.

Akiyama launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Young Jump magazine in 2023. Shueisha will publish the manga's 12th compiled book volume on October 19.

Akiyama launched the Killer in Love ( Kimi ni Koisuru Satsujinki ) manga on Shogakukan 's Manga ONE and Ura Sunday services in January 2021. The manga ended in 2022. Comikey publishes the manga digitally in English.

title: i☆Ris Voice Actress Idol Unit to Disband at End of 2027
content:
The official website for the i☆Ris voice actress idol unit announced on Sunday that the group will end its activities at the end of 2027, which also marks the group's 15th anniversary. The announcement explained that all members and their staff have been discussing the future of the group and of each individual member since last year, and have come to the decision to end the group's activities next year. The group expressed gratitude to all the fans who have supported them until now.

The group will hold its 14th anniversary live on November 3 at the Yokohama Arena.

i☆Ris came together in July 2012 between six winners of avex and 81 Produce 's AniSon Vocal Audition competition, and released the debut single "Color" that November. In addition to being musical performers, all members are also anime voice actresses. The unit now consists of Saki Yamakita , Yū Serizawa , Himika Akaneya , Yūki Wakai , and Miyu Kubota . (Former member Azuki Shibuya left the group on March 31, 2021.)

The group has performed theme songs for such anime as Pretty Rhythm Rainbow Live , Mushibugyō , Fantasista Stella , Hantsu x Trash , Twin Star Exorcists , Akiba's Trip: The Animation , PriPara , Idol Time PriPara , Magical Girl Site , Wise Man's Grandchild , Magical Sempai , and more recently for Honō no Tōkyūjo: Dodge Danko dodgeball anime. All original six members were also in the main cast of the 2014 PriPara television anime.

The unit won the Singing Award in the 10th Annual Seiyū Awards in March 2016 and performed the group's first concert at the famed Nippon Budōkan arena that November.

The anime film i☆Ris the Movie -Full Energy!!- premiered in Japan in May 2024, and the Live & Documentary Movie ～ i☆Ris on STAGE～ documentary film opened in Japan in September that same year. Both films were part of the unit's 10th anniversary celebration.

The group previously inspired a webcomic tentatively titled Shūkan i☆Ris ("Weekly i☆Ris ") in 2016.

title: Yasuki Tanaka's Ghost Fixers Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content:
Tanaka launched the manga on Shonen Jump+ in March 2024. Shueisha published the manga's seventh compiled volume on March 4.

MANGA Plus is publishing the manga in English, and it describes the story:

Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS! In said town lives Hifumi, a middle school boy, who one day encounters a girl who just moved in... Help "correct" the supernatural in this action-packed tale from Yasuki Tanaka , creator of " Summer Time Rendering "!

Tanaka's Summer Time Rendering manga inspired an anime in 2022. Disney+ streamed the anime worldwide and exclusively in Japan. Ayumu Watanabe ( Space Brothers , Children of the Sea ) directed the anime.

A live-action project was announced in 2021, and the project will be a film that will open in Japan in 2027.

The manga also inspired a game that launched on PlayStation 4 and Nintendo Switch in January 2023.

Tanaka launched the manga on Shonen Jump+ in October 2017, and the manga's 13th and final volume shipped in Japan in April 2021. Shueisha launched its MANGA Plus online service with the English version of the manga in January 2019. Udon Entertainment licensed the series for print in 2021.
